name: @pipeworx/mcp-semanticscholar

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Search 200M+ academic papers on Semantic Scholar by keyword or exact title. Returns titles, authors, year, venue, CITATION COUNTS, DOI, and open-access PDF links. PREFER for "how many citations does <paper title> have", "citation count for <paper>", "how cited is <paper>" — search the title and read citationCount off the match. Optionally filter by year range and field of study. Keyless.

query.description: Search query, e.g. "transformer attention mechanism" or "CRISPR gene editing".

year.description: Filter by publication year or range, e.g. "2023" or "2020-2024".

fields_of_study.description: Filter by field of study, e.g. "Computer Science", "Medicine", "Biology", "Physics".

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description: Get full metadata for a single paper by ID. Accepts a Semantic Scholar paper ID, or a prefixed ID like "DOI:10.1145/3292500", "arXiv:2106.15928", or "CorpusId:215416146". Returns abstract, TLDR summary, authors, venue, citation/reference counts, fields of study, and open-access PDF. Keyless.

paper_id.description: Paper identifier. A Semantic Scholar ID, or prefixed: "DOI:10...", "arXiv:2106.15928", "CorpusId:...".

tools.name: get_paper_citations
tools.description: Semantic Scholar cited-by lookup: list the papers that CITE a given paper (the works citing it), with their titles, authors, year, and citation counts. Use for "cited-by papers", "who cites this paper", "papers that cite X", forward citation tracing, and finding follow-up work. Keyless.

paper_id.description: Paper identifier. A Semantic Scholar ID, or prefixed: "DOI:10...", "arXiv:2106.15928", "CorpusId:...".

limit.description: Max citing papers to return (default 10, max 25).

tools.name: get_author
tools.description: Search for academic authors by name on Semantic Scholar. Returns up to 5 matches with affiliations, paper count, total citation count, h-index, and profile URL. Keyless.

name.description: Author name to search for, e.g. "Yoshua Bengio".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-semanticscholar forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the semanticscholar pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
